groups.name: Prettier configuration to exclude review artifacts
groups.rationale: Adds `.lavish/` directory to `.prettierignore` so Prettier does not reformat recorded review artifacts that are written once and never edited as source.
groups.watch: The comment must accurately describe what `.lavish/` contains and why it should not be reformatted; if the directory serves a different purpose or is edited as source code, this exclusion could hide formatting issues.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
